Animation evidence fixture

Each panel states its element, property, keyframes, duration, and timing. Running animations use linear timing and repeat from page load. Each has a twin held still at 25 percent of its first iteration, with the value it should show. This page does not test prefers-reduced-motion, so the Windows animation setting does not stop it. Script runs only in the panels that say so.

Skip link

#skip-link, transform: a transition from translateY(-120%) to translateY(0), 1 s, linear, on focus. Press Tab once from the top of the page. No held twin: a transition runs only on a change of state.

Rotation

#rotation, transform: rotate(0deg) to rotate(360deg), 4 s, linear, infinite.

Running

Held: rotate(90deg)

Separate transform properties

#separate: translate 0 to 120px, rotate 0deg to 180deg, scale 1 to 1.5, 4 s, linear, infinite.

Running

Held: translate 30px, rotate 45deg, scale 1.125

Fade

#fade, opacity: 1 to 0.2, 2 s, linear, infinite, alternate.

Running

Held: opacity 0.8

Blur

#blur, filter: blur(0px) to blur(6px), 3 s, linear, infinite, alternate.

Running

Held: blur(1.5px)

Frosted glass

#frost, backdrop-filter: blur(0px) to blur(8px), over stripes, 3 s, linear, infinite, alternate.

Running

Held: blur(2px)

Compositor scroll

#scroller, its scroll offset. The button runs script: scrollTo with behavior: "smooth" to the top of row 30, or back to row 1. Also scroll it with the wheel.

    Background color

    #background, background-color: rgb(204, 0, 0) to rgb(0, 0, 204), 2 s, linear, infinite, alternate.

    Running

    Held: rgb(153, 0, 51)

    Clip path, same shape

    #clip-inset, clip-path: inset(10%) to inset(30% 5%), 3 s, linear, infinite, alternate.

    Running

    Held: inset(15% 8.75%)

    Clip path, circle

    #clip-circle, clip-path: circle(20% at 50% 50%) to circle(50% at 50% 50%), 3 s, linear, infinite, alternate.

    Running

    Held: circle(27.5% at 50% 50%)

    Clip path, change of shape

    #clip-change, clip-path: inset(10%) to circle(40% at 50% 50%), 4 s, linear, infinite, alternate. The shapes do not interpolate, so the shape changes at half way.

    Running

    Held: inset(10%)

    Animated images

    Eight frames of 250 ms, repeating, made by make_images.py. Each frame is a solid color with its number in white.

    #text-color, color: rgb(204, 0, 0) to rgb(0, 0, 204), 2 s, linear, infinite, alternate. Not run on the compositor.

    Held: rgb(153, 0, 51)

    Main thread, layout

    #layout-width, width: 100px to 300px, 3 s, linear, infinite, alternate. Lays out at each frame.

    Running

    Held: width 150px

    Web Animations

    #web-animation, transform: the button runs script, element.animate() of translateX(0) to translateX(80px), 2 s, linear, infinite, alternate. A second press cancels it.

    Focus ring

    #focus-ring, outline-color: a transition from transparent to rgb(0, 80, 200), 1 s, linear, on :focus-visible. Move focus to it with Tab.
